The Wichita State difference
Apply What You Learn
Through applied learning internships, co-ops and mentorships you'll work side-by-side
with established professionals, building contacts, confidence and a strong resume
before graduation.
Learn more
Research
With more than 30 renowned centers and institutes and state-of-the-art labs and research
facilities, Wichita State students do real research that impacts the community, the
economy and people's lives.
Learn more
Innovation
At Wichita State, our students are the engine of innovation, with a collaborative
infrastructure that helps develop new ideas, and get new projects and businesses off
the ground.
Learn more
THE COLLEGE TOUR
Internships and Applied Learning
Wichita State’s applied learning model gives students real-world experience through
internships, research, and industry partnerships. With hands-on opportunities in every
major, Shockers graduate with the skills, connections, and confidence to succeed in
their careers.
More The College Tour videos
By the numbers
High quality and affordable tuition make Wichita State a great value. We're among
the most affordable four-year colleges and universities in the U.S.
See how we stack up
Wichita State continues to rise in the National Science Foundation's ranking of U.S.
college engineering R&D expenditures
Learn more
As one of the fastest-growing research universities in the country, Wichita State
continues a run of record-setting annual research expenditures.
Learn more
For 15 straight years, WSU has been the top four-year transfer destination for Kansas
college students. Potential transfer students can see how the credits they have already
taken can apply to different degrees by using our Transfer Gateway.
Learn more
